pages.lesson:
LESSON: SARUFI 10.4.1 NYAKATI NA HALI. ULIOPITA ULIOPO UJAO

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.4: Sarufi 10.4.1 Nyakati na hali. uliopita uliopo ujao

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 10.4.1 Nyakati na hali. uliopita uliopo ujao. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita uliopo na ujao kwenye vitenzi
2. kutambua vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao kwenye matini
3. kutunga sentensi akitumia vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita uliopo na ujao kwenye vitenzi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita uliopo na ujao kwenye vitenzi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao kwenye matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao kwenye matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutunga sentensi akitumia vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao
   In simple words: practise until you can kutunga sentensi akitumia vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 10.4.1 Nyakati na hali. uliopita uliopo ujao using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 10.4.1 Nyakati na hali. uliopita uliopo ujao in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 10.4.1 Nyakati na hali. uliopita uliopo ujao to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 10.4.1 Nyakati na hali. uliopita uliopo ujao.
4. Show that you can: kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita uliopo na ujao kwenye vitenzi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 10.4.1 Nyakati na hali. uliopita uliopo ujao using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 10.4.1 Nyakati na hali. uliopita uliopo ujao important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua viambishi vya wakati uliopita uliopo na ujao kwenye vitenzi
2. kutambua vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao kwenye matini
3. kutunga sentensi akitumia vitenzi katika wakati uliopita, uliopo na ujao

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
